title: Proper Homotopy Nonrigidity of Open Contractible Manifolds
summary: We study whether proper homotopy equivalence classifies open contractible manifolds arising as interiors of compact contractible manifolds. In dimensions three and four, it does: any two such interiors that are properly homotopy equivalent are homeomorphic. In every even dimension $N\geq 6$ and every odd dimension $N\geq 9$, however, it does not: a single proper homotopy type contains infinitely many pairwise nonhomeomorphic smooth open contractible $N$-manifolds. The cases of dimensions five and seven remain unresolved.
